title: Shark holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M62 30 Q60 45 55 55' fill='none' stroke='#ffcc00' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='20' rx='12' ry='14' fill='#ff4466'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='20' rx='12' ry='14' fill='none' stroke='#ff88aa' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- balloon knot -->
  <polygon points='62,33 66,33 64,37' fill='#cc2244'/>
  <!-- balloon shine -->
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='15' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#ffccdd' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- shark body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='62' rx='26' ry='16' fill='#5a9ec4'/>
  <!-- shark belly -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='70' rx='20' ry='8' fill='#b8dce8'/>
  <!-- dorsal fin -->
  <polygon points='38,47 45,32 52,47' fill='#4a88ae'/>
  <!-- tail fin -->
  <polygon points='17,58 8,48 14,62 8,72 17,66' fill='#4a88ae'/>
  <!-- pectoral fin -->
  <polygon points='48,66 58,74 46,74' fill='#4a88ae'/>
  <!-- shark head area -->
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='60' rx='12' ry='12' fill='#5a9ec4'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M56 66 Q62 72 68 66' fill='none' stroke='#2a4a6a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- teeth -->
  <polygon points='58,66 60,70 62,66' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <polygon points='63,66 65,70 67,66' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='56' r='3' fill='#1a2a4a'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='55' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- gills -->
  <path d='M54 56 Q52 60 54 64' fill='none' stroke='#3a7a9a' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <path d='M50 56 Q48 60 50 64' fill='none' stroke='#3a7a9a' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <!-- arm holding string -->
  <path d='M52 70 Q56 62 60 58' fill='none' stroke='#5a9ec4' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- hand -->
  <circle cx='60' cy='57' r='2.5' fill='#4a88ae'/>
</svg>
